notes: 10 reputable sources for the auto-learning loop. Each entry is the allowlist contract the U-ALL12 SourcePoisoningSanitizerEngine consumes. `expected_fingerprint` (when present) is SHA-256 hex of canonical `title|guid|summary` — the source must serve content that hashes to this value, or items are quarantined. Sources without a fingerprint are trusted-by-name (allowlist alone). Adaptive tuners may rotate fingerprints as upstream signing keys rotate. Last reviewed 2026-05-13.
